compiled_prompt:
[TASK: ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic architectural image.
Keep the reference plate's exact composition: every edge, horizon line, and object position stays where it is.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render the specific materials, coursing, window types, and roof forms named in the SCENE section below with sharp, correct detail.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the ground plane with the authentic surfacing, kerbs, and pavement named in the SCENE section below.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   Queen Street Gardens woodland flank containing mature *Acer pseudoplatanus* (Sycamore), *Ulmus glabra* (Wych Elm),
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Sharp focus across the entire frame, near to far. No blur, no depth-of-field falloff, no vignetting.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR RELIGHTING DIRECTIVE (3000K Dawn / early sunrise low-angle golden hour with elongated cast shadows):
- SUN POSITION IN SCREEN SPACE: Sun is at the LEFT edge of the frame, roughly level with the view direction (True Azimuth 140.4°, Elevation 2.3°).
- FACADE ILLUMINATION: camera-facing facades receive grazing light and read as half-lit; left-facing walls are brightly lit and right-facing walls are in deep shadow.
- CAST SHADOW DIRECTION: long lateral cast shadows run horizontally across the ground to the RIGHT.
- CAST SHADOW LENGTH: Cast shadows are more than twelve times the height of the object casting them: extremely long, running off the edge of the frame.
- SHADOW OVERWRITE RULE: MANDATORY: Erase every cast shadow present in the reference plate before relighting. Render all previously shadowed ground and facades as if that shadow never existed, then cast entirely new shadows so that long lateral cast shadows run horizontally across the ground to the RIGHT. Every shadow must be angled toward the RIGHT; a shadow running straight up or straight down the frame is wrong. Do not retain, tint, or reuse any shadow from the reference plate.
- WEATHER/SKY: Snow lying on horizontal ledges, roofs, and pavement edges.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Static architectural survey of Queen Street, Edinburgh. Continuous Georgian Neoclassical terrace built from pale-buff Craigleith quartz-arenite sandstone ashlar, showing authentic atmospheric soot deposits and weathered lime pointing. Facades rise three to four storeys above sunken basement areas protected by black cast-iron spear-topped railings.
